CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m3_score_insert_allowed(contest uuid, player uuid, round uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog' AS $function$
  SELECT public.is_contest_owner(contest)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.contest_players p
      WHERE p.id = player AND p.contest_id = contest AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.round_player_assignments a
      JOIN public.round_scorer_scopes s
        ON s.contest_id = a.contest_id AND s.round_id = a.round_id AND s.group_id = a.group_id
       AND s.user_id = auth.uid() AND s.status = 'approved'
      WHERE a.contest_id = contest AND a.player_id = player AND a.round_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM round
    );
$function$

rules.def: CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS ON SELECT TO public.channel_effectiveness DO INSTEAD SELECT source, count(*) AS total_signups, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_id IN ( SELECT profiles.id FROM profiles WHERE (profiles.is_premium = true)))) AS premium_conversions, round((((count(*) FILTER (WHERE (user_id IN ( SELECT profiles.id FROM profiles WHERE (profiles.is_premium = true)))))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS premium_conversion_rate FROM marketing_events WHERE ((event_name = 'user_signup'::text) AND (created_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))) GROUP BY source ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

rules.def: CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS ON SELECT TO public.funnel_health DO INSTEAD WITH this_week AS ( SELECT avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.downloads > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.downloads)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS signup_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.signups > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS activation_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.first_settlement_sent)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS settlement_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.second_scan_within_7d)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS retention_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.invited_friend)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS invite_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.signups > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.converted_premium)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS premium_rate, avg(funnel_snapshots.avg_time_to_first_scan_sec) AS avg_ttfs FROM funnel_snapshots WHERE (funnel_snapshots.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 7)) ), last_week AS ( SELECT avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.downloads > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.downloads)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS signup_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.signups > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS activation_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.first_settlement_sent)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS settlement_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.second_scan_within_7d)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS retention_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.invited_friend)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.first_scan_completed)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS invite_rate, avg( CASE WHEN (funnel_snapshots.signups > 0) THEN ((funnel_snapshots.converted_premium)::numeric / (funnel_snapshots.signups)::numeric) ELSE NULL::numeric END) AS premium_rate, avg(funnel_snapshots.avg_time_to_first_scan_sec) AS avg_ttfs FROM funnel_snapshots WHERE ((funnel_snapshots.date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 14)) AND (funnel_snapshots.date < (CURRENT_DATE - 7))) ) SELECT round((tw.signup_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS signup_rate_pct, round((tw.activation_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS activation_rate_pct, round((tw.settlement_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS settlement_rate_pct, round((tw.retention_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS retention_rate_pct, round((tw.invite_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS invite_rate_pct, round((tw.premium_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS premium_rate_pct, round(tw.avg_ttfs) AS avg_ttfs_sec, round(((tw.activation_rate - lw.activation_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS activation_wow_delta, round(((tw.settlement_rate - lw.settlement_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS settlement_wow_delta, round(((tw.invite_rate - lw.invite_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS invite_wow_delta FROM this_week tw, last_week lw;

rules.def: CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS ON SELECT TO public.golfcore_usage_summary DO INSTEAD SELECT to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS month, (count(*))::integer AS calls, 500 AS cap, (((count(*))::numeric * 100.0) / (500)::numeric) AS pct_used, CASE WHEN (count(*) = 0) THEN (0)::numeric ELSE ((count(*))::numeric / GREATEST((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - (date_trunc('month'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))) / EXTRACT(epoch FROM ((date_trunc('month'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) + '1 mon'::interval) - date_trunc('month'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))))), 0.000000001)) END AS projected_month_end, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_quota_error))::integer AS quota_errors, ( SELECT golfcore_usage_1.ratelimit_remaining FROM golfcore_usage golfcore_usage_1 WHERE ((golfcore_usage_1.month = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM'::text)) AND (golfcore_usage_1.ratelimit_remaining IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY golfcore_usage_1.called_at DESC, golfcore_usage_1.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_remaining, max(called_at) AS last_call_at FROM golfcore_usage WHERE (month = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM'::text));
rules.name: _RETURN

rules.def: CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS ON SELECT TO public.golfcore_usage_summary_v2 DO INSTEAD WITH clock AS ( SELECT now() AS as_of, to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM'::text) AS month, ((date_trunc('month'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) + '1 mon'::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text) AS month_end ), ledger AS ( SELECT count(*) AS ledger_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE golfcore_usage.is_quota_error) AS quota_errors, COALESCE(bool_or(golfcore_usage.quota_tripped), false) AS quota_tripped FROM golfcore_usage WHERE (golfcore_usage.month = ( SELECT clock.month FROM clock)) ), recent AS ( SELECT count(*) AS calls_7d FROM golfcore_usage WHERE (golfcore_usage.called_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) ), latest AS ( SELECT GREATEST(0, (golfcore_usage.ratelimit_limit - golfcore_usage.ratelimit_remaining)) AS header_used FROM golfcore_usage WHERE ((golfcore_usage.month = ( SELECT clock.month FROM clock)) AND (golfcore_usage.ratelimit_limit IS NOT NULL) AND (golfcore_usage.ratelimit_remaining IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY golfcore_usage.called_at DESC, golfcore_usage.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), effective AS ( SELECT clock.as_of, clock.month, clock.month_end, ledger.ledger_rows, ledger.quota_errors, ledger.quota_tripped, recent.calls_7d, GREATEST(ledger.ledger_rows, (COALESCE(( SELECT latest.header_used FROM latest), 0))::bigint) AS calls_effective FROM ((clock CROSS JOIN ledger) CROSS JOIN recent) ) SELECT month, ledger_rows, ledger_rows AS calls, calls_effective, 500 AS cap, (((calls_effective)::numeric * 100.0) / (500)::numeric) AS pct_effective, calls_7d, ((calls_effective)::numeric + (((calls_7d)::numeric / 7.0) * GREATEST((0)::numeric, (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (month_end - as_of)) / 86400.0)))) AS projected_month_end_7d, quota_errors, quota_tripped, as_of FROM effective;
rules.name: _RETURN

14)) AND (funnel_snapshots.date < (CURRENT_DATE - 7))) ) SELECT round((tw.signup_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS signup_rate_pct, round((tw.activation_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS activation_rate_pct, round((tw.settlement_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS settlement_rate_pct, round((tw.retention_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS retention_rate_pct, round((tw.invite_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS invite_rate_pct, round((tw.premium_rate * (100)::numeric), 1) AS premium_rate_pct, round(tw.avg_ttfs) AS avg_ttfs_sec, round(((tw.activation_rate - lw.activation_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS activation_wow_delta, round(((tw.settlement_rate - lw.settlement_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS settlement_wow_delta, round(((tw.invite_rate - lw.invite_rate) * (100)::numeric), 1) AS invite_wow_delta FROM this_week tw, last_week lw;
